design.environment: TASK_A switches to TASK_B; matching task instruction earns energy
design.primary_metric: final share of surviving population carrying TASK_B
design.paired_holdout_metric: paired per-seed difference in final TASK_B share; 95% normal-approximation CI
design.adaptation_acceptance_criterion: The mutation arm's paired 95% CI lower bound must exceed zero against both controls; otherwise report no demonstrated adaptation.
design.holdout_warning: TASK_B is the shifted environment under test; the toy model has no external validation data

adaptation_criterion.description: Evidence requires the paired 95% CI lower bound for mutation-minus-control TASK_B share to exceed zero against both controls.

interpretation_limits: This is simulated evolutionary selection, not an AI model updating its weights.
The task and reward are engineered toy rules, not biological evidence.
Seed variation estimates simulator variability only; external validity is not established.

provenance.source: deterministic local digital VM; no network/model calls
provenance.validation: 29 targeted unittest cases: 28 passed and 1 skipped because optional trained_local endpoint is not running
